The Ik'thik Colossus is an extremely large Kunchong that appears from the Dread Wastes breaking down a large section of the Serpent's Spine into the Valley of the Four Winds. After it is slain, its corpse blocks the hole that it created in the wall and remains there.

The Ik'thik are a swarm of mantid found at the Dread Wastes, the Krasarang Wilds, and the Valley of the Four Winds. Their ultimate aim is to breach the Serpent's Spine and press forward into the Valley of the Four Winds, with Stoneplow being their first target, though they are later found assigned guard duty of two of the Kypari trees: Kypari Ik and Kypari Zar.

Ihgaluk Crag is the home of the Skumblade tribe of saurok on the Isle of Thunder. Situated between Shaol'mara / Violet Rise to the northeast, Za'Tual to the west and the Diremoor to the north, the crag has a commanding view of the southern portion of the isle. The Skumblade practice a particularly nasty way of life, by spreading disease far and wide to weaken their enemies. The Shoulder of the Chamberlain can be found at one of several locations in the crag for The Crumbled Chamberlain. There is additionally a cave off on the southeast side of the crag along the shore which houses a Primal Ritual Stone.

Ihgaluk Roaches carpet Ihgaluk Crag, feeding on Fetid Meat Piles and the filth found in the filth pool. Crush 200 roaches within a minute to earn the Pandaria quest achievement Ready for RAAAAIIIIDDD?!?ing.
Ihgaluk Basilisks are basilisks located in Ihgaluk Crag on the Isle of Thunder.

The Icon of Pandaria, also known as the Pandaren Crest, is the racial symbol of the pandaren, and the class icon of the monk class, whose teachings originated from ancient Pandaria. It consists of a small black-green metal plate with a paw print and spiral-symbol in the center over a wooden shield. The shield is decorated with symbols of the August Celestials in their respective cardinal directions (Xuen-North/upward, Yu'lon-East/right, Chi-Ji-South/downward, and Niuzao-West/left). Two bo-staves are crossed on the shield. One holds a tea kettle and an ale gourd, showing the laid-back and carefree aspect of Pandaren culture. Igira's Watch is the choke point to the Zaqali Caldera in western Zaralek Cavern. Named for the elder Igira, the watch is guarded by unnamed cragrunners, farseers, infernoblades, and scaleseekers. Additionally, crackling hounds, magma bursters, molten droplets, rousing flames, and volcanic deepstriders are present. The watch is bordered by the Battlefield Ruins and Elders' Gift to the northeast, Burning Oasis and the Gaze of Neltharion to the east, the Molten Overflow and Sulfur Wastes to the southeast, and Zaqali Caldera to the southwest, west, and northwest. Ilthalaine is a night elf quest giver located in Shadowglen in Teldrassil. Having died during the Burning of Teldrassil, his soul ended up in the Maw as a result of the Arbiter's incapacitation. While being imprisoned within the Tremaculum, he was rescued by mortals aligned with the Night Fae Covenant, at the urging of Ysera. Following his liberation, he came to reside in the Heart of the Forest within Ardenweald. Following the blossoming of the World Tree, Amirdrassil, from the dream, Ilthalaine as a Wisp can be found in Bel'ameth with many other Kaldorei who perished during the War of the Thorns

Imbue refers to a temporary enhancement that can be added to equipment. Any piece of equipment can only be the subject of a single imbue at a time. Subsequent attempts to imbues will overwrite any existing imbue, but not before asking if you want to do so. Imbue effects stack with existing permanent enchantment effects. Imbues provide a variety of effects and can greatly improve gameplay. For list of all permanent enchantments see Enchantments by slot.

The Illidari (also known as Illidan's Forces, or Illidan's forces, and Illidan's army) are the faction of Illidan Stormrage, representing his servants and a specific, elite faction of his army made of demon hunters. Under the Slayer's leadership it changed to include Broken, naga, shivarra forces, and various factions that have banded together under the Betrayer's rule. During the Invasion of Outland, the Illidari were one of the prime enemies of the Alliance and Horde, the other being the Burning Legion. The Image of Archmage Vargoth is a quest giver located in the Netherstorm. The image is summonable using a staff, and appears near where the player is when the staff is used. At the end of the questline, questers head into the Violet Tower to located the archmage's physical self. Since the final quest does not require you to return the staff, he is frequently summoned at other locations - including instances.
